text: Jean Martin's The Raped Little Runaway was banned in Ireland by the Censorship of Publications Board in March 2016, the first book banned by the board since 1998. The board found it “indecent” and “obscene” because it contained multiple descriptions of child rape. A 42-year-old man was convicted at Ennis Circuit Criminal Court of possessing the book in 2014, two years before it was banned. He was convicted under child pornography legislation rather than for possession of a banned book, and was fined €500.
